text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket has been waiting her whole
life for today. This is her
chance to
accomplish her dream of winning the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Exhale...

Hand on her chest, she lets out a deep
breath. She slowly opens her
eyes and
gazes at the turf at the end of the tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even standing behind her, I can tell she's
never been so focused.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she's normally making a racket
screaming our ears off.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oooh... Even I'm getting nervous...

All of Team Sirius is waiting with bated
breath as they watch Winning
Ticket's
valiant figure from afar. But the stoic
competitor breaks the
silence.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Nnngh! Hrrrgh! It's no good, I'm all itchy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I get all tense when I focus! And when I
get tense, I get itchy!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: That's the Tickezo I know.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: That's the Tickezo I know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you're really that itchy, we can use our
special trick to give you a
decent send off.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Special trick?

Mejiro McQueen gives the signal to the
others, and they all raise their
open palms
up behind Winning Ticket's back.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: O-one, two... three!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Good luck!
Whack!

All at once, they slap Winning Ticket on
the back.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hyaaah! That was hard!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You're good to go! Now, have the best
Derby ever, Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You know I will! I'm gonna run the race of
my life!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Until now, the Derby has been something
exciting that I aspired to.
But this time, I'm
actually in it...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I've got my rivals, my team, and my trainer with me... Now this is my Derby!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Just watch me!
